title: Paid open call for comic artists - Paradise Towers 2 backup strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! (Full details via @cutawaycomics. Contact via DM or email as mentioned in comments.)

author: young.onion
title: Hiring kawaii artists for stationery collection
content: WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens. How to apply: Follow us, comment, send DM with portfolio or form in bio. You can also mail us info@youngonion.in
